sense: to a channel or a list

terms.comment: Traupman’s verb; classically to write one’s name underneath, to sign (Lewis & Short). With the dative of what one subscribes to (statiōnī subscrībere), our construction, after the classical subscrībere alicui, to back someone. To unsubscribe, Traupman gives cessāre.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
